blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce NavHarness, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, NavHarness achieves 83.3% success and 1.51 m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言导航(VLN)要求包含的代理以指示和观察为基础产生行动. 通用多式联运代理人为这项任务提供了有希望的基础,但选择可行的当地行动并不能确保执行工作与预期路线保持一致,特别是在长期任务中。 此外,累积的互动历史增加了后续决定所需的投入,导致大量推断间接费用。 为此,我们引入了NavHarness,这是一个VLN代理框架,其中包括一个为当地行动设定适应目标的目标代理,一个能动态核实一个目标是否完成的验证代理,一个用于多模式环境压缩的记忆代理,以及一个用于执行适应目标的Visumotor代理. 具体来说,目标代理人根据指示、当前观察和执行历史制定适应性目标。 然后,Visumotor Agent执行导航动作来达到每个目标,而校验Agent则使用一个针对特定目标的核查问题来动态地评估所观察到的结果是否符合预定的完成条件. 验证目标完成后为内存代理公司标出一个边界来压缩相应的多模式交互历史,同时保存后续导航所需的信息. 我们评价R2R-CE和RxR-CE的导航,审查三个模型骨干之间的框架变体,研究执行过程中的背景演变. 对于现实世界的评价,NavHarness实现了 83.3%的成功率和1.51米的8条有挑战性的航道通航误差,每条航道评估三次。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow natural-language instructions using visual observations ( Anderson et al., 2018 ) . In continuous environments, the agent must translate route descriptions into physical movement while avoiding obstacles and recognizing when it has reached the destination ( Krantz et al., 2020 ) . Training on large-scale expert trajectories has driven substantial advances in task-specific policies and navigation foundation models ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ) . However, an instruction cannot prescribe the appropriate response to every situation encountered during execution. Following the intended route therefore requires an agent to continually interpret new observations in the context of the instruction and adapt its actions as the environment is revealed.
blocks.zh: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN)要求有被体现的代理,使用视觉观测来遵循自然语言指令(Anderson等,2018年). 在连续的环境中,毒剂必须将路由描述转化为物理运动,同时避免障碍并识别已到达目的地的时间(克兰茨等,2020年). 大型专家轨迹培训推动专项任务政策和导航基础模型取得实质性进展(张等等,2024;程等,2025;Quen Team,2026). 然而,指令不能规定对执行过程中遇到的每一种情况作出适当的反应。 因此,按照预定路线,代理人必须不断根据指示解释新的观察,并随着环境的暴露而调整其行动。

blocks.en: General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for such adaptive decision-making. Agent frameworks allow models to interleave reasoning, tool use, and environmental feedback ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . In VLN, this interaction pattern enables a multimodal model to interpret the current scene, execute movements through navigation tools, and use the resulting observations to guide subsequent decisions. Recent navigation agents have demonstrated the potential of this approach through competitive performance with navigation foundation models ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, deciding what to do at an individual step is only part of the problem. Sustained navigation also requires keeping local execution consistent with the route instruction and managing the information carried forward between decisions.
blocks.zh: 通用多式联运代理商为这种适应性决策提供了有希望的基础。 代理框架允许模型交互推理,工具使用,以及环境反馈(姚等,2023. ). 在VLN中,这种交互模式使得多模式模型能够解释当前场景,通过导航工具执行移动,并使用所得出的观测结果来指导后继决定. 近期的通航代理通过与通航地基模型的竞争性能(李等,2026;周等,2026;陈等,2026),展现出这一方法的潜力. 然而,在个别阶段决定做什么只是问题的一部分。 持续通航还需要保持当地执行与路由指示一致,并管理决策之间传递的信息.

blocks.en: Two challenges arise in this setting. First, locally plausible actions do not ensure consistency with the intended route . Partial observations, detours, and mistaken turns can cause the actual trajectory to diverge from the agent’s assumed progress. Without checking whether an intended local objective has been achieved, the agent may base subsequent decisions on an incorrect interpretation of its progress along the route, allowing deviations to compound over long horizons ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Second, accumulating interaction history increases inference overhead . Repeatedly including past observations and tool interactions enlarges the input required for subsequent decisions. Indiscriminate truncation, however, can remove landmarks, corrections, or unfinished objectives that remain necessary for navigation and recovery. An explicit distinction between what has been accomplished and what remains unresolved offers a common basis for addressing both challenges.
blocks.zh: 在这一背景下出现了两个挑战。 首先,当地可行的行动不能确保与预定路线保持一致。 部分的观察、绕道和误转会导致实际轨迹偏离代理人假定的进展。 在不检查预期的局部目标是否已经实现的情况下,代理商可能根据对其沿途进展的不正确解释做出后续决定,允许偏移在长地平线上复合(周等,2026). 第二,积累互动历史增加了推断间接费用。 重复地包括过去的观察和工具互动,扩大了以后决定所需的投入。 然而,不分青红皂白地缩短可以去除导航和恢复所必需的地标、更正或未完成的目标。 明确区分已经取得的成就和尚未解决的问题,为应付这两项挑战提供了一个共同的基础。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce NavHarness, an agentic VLN framework comprising a Goal Agent, a Verify Agent, a Memory Agent, and a Visuomotor Agent (Figure 1 ). To keep local execution aligned with the route instruction, the framework couples adaptive goal generation with explicit completion verification . The Goal Agent formulates local goals from the instruction, current observation, and execution history, allowing the immediate objective to reflect the situation actually encountered. Each goal is paired with a verification question that specifies an observable completion condition. At each step, the Visuomotor Agent executes actions toward the goal, while the Verify Agent checks subsequent observations to assess whether that condition has been satisfied. Verification feedback guides whether to continue execution, advance to the next goal, or revise the objective to recover from a deviation while retaining unfinished task state. This separates goal pursuit from completion assessment, grounding progress updates in observed outcomes rather than issued actions alone.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们介绍了NavHarness,这是一个由目标代理、核查代理、记忆代理和Visumotor代理(图1)组成的VLN代理框架。 为了使当地执行与路线指示保持一致,框架夫妇在明确完成核查的情况下,适应目标生成。 目标代理人从指示、当前观察和执行历史中制定地方目标,使直接目标能够反映实际遇到的情况。 每个目标都附有一个核查问题,其中具体说明可观察到的完成条件。 在每一个步骤上,Visumotor代理执行针对目标的行动,而核查代理检查随后的观察,以评估该条件是否得到满足。 核查反馈指导是继续实施,推进下一个目标,还是修改目标,从偏差中恢复,同时保留未完成的任务状态. 这把追求目标与完成评估区分开来,把最新进展建立在观察到的结果上,而不是仅仅发布行动。

blocks.en: Moreover, we introduce progress-aware multimodal context compression to limit the growth of interaction history while preserving information needed for navigation. The Memory Agent uses verified goal completion as a boundary for compression, distinguishing completed interactions that can be summarized from context still needed for ongoing execution. It condenses the multimodal history of completed goals into compact summaries that preserve route progress, relevant landmarks, and corrections, while retaining recent evidence for the active goal and carrying unfinished state forward when goals are revised. Subsequent decisions can thus build on prior progress without repeatedly processing the full sequence of past observations and interactions. By coupling compression boundaries and information retention to verified progress, this design reduces the historical context carried into subsequent decisions while avoiding the loss of unresolved objectives and recovery-relevant evidence that indiscriminate truncation can cause.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们采用有进步意识的多模式环境压缩,以限制互动历史的发展,同时保存导航所需的信息。 内存代理使用已核实的目标完成作为压缩的边界,区分完成的互动,这些互动可以归纳与正在进行的执行仍然需要的背景. 它将已完成目标的多模式历史归纳为简明摘要,以保留路线进展、相关地标和校正,同时保留积极目标的最新证据,并在修订目标时推进未完成状态。 因此,随后的决定可以在先前进展的基础上更上一层楼,而不重复处理过去的观察和互动的全部顺序。 通过将压缩边界和信息保留与核实的进展相配合,这一设计减少了历史背景,从而进入了随后的决定,同时避免了未实现的目标的损失和不分青红皂白的截断可能造成的与恢复相关的证据.

blocks.en: We evaluate NavHarness on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, compare framework variants across three model backbones, and analyze context evolution during execution. With GPT-6-Astra as backbone, NavHarness achieves success rates (SR) of 79.0% on R2R-CE and 82.5% on RxR-CE, compared with 74.0% and 76.3%, respectively, for Codex CLI using the same backbone. Analyses of execution traces further show that compression reduces decision input at selected navigation stages. In real-world evaluation, NavHarness achieves 83.3% SR and 1.51 m navigation error across eight challenging routes, each evaluated three times.
blocks.zh: 我们在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上评价了NavHarness,比较了三个模型骨干之间的框架变体,并分析了执行过程中的背景演变. 以GPT-6-Astra为骨干,NavHarness在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上分别实现了79.0%和82.5%的成功率(SR),而使用同一骨干而使用的Codex CLI则分别达到了74.0%和76.3%. 对执行痕迹的分析进一步表明,压缩会减少选定导航阶段的决定输入. 在现实世界评价中,NavHarness在8条挑战性航道上实现了83.3%的SR和1.51米的导航误差,每条航道都进行了3次评价.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce NavHarness, an agentic VLN framework that couples adaptive local goals with goal-specific completion verification, grounding progress updates in observed outcomes and supporting continued execution and recovery along the intended route. • We develop a progress-aware multimodal memory mechanism that uses verified goal completion to define compression boundaries, summarizing completed interactions while preserving the context and unfinished task state needed for subsequent navigation. • Experimental results on VLN-CE, and Real-World show that the NavHarness outperforms navigation foundation models which trained on large-scale datasets in a zero-shot setting.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们引入了NavHarness,这是一个具有促进作用的VLN框架,将适应性地方目标与特定目标的完成情况核查结合起来,确定所观察到成果的最新进展情况,并支持沿着预定路线继续实施和恢复。 我们开发了一种进步意识多模式记忆机制,利用已核实的目标完成来定义压缩边界,总结已完成的相互作用,同时保留后续导航所需的上下文和未完成的任务状态. • VLN-CE的实验结果和Real-World显示,NavHarness的导航基础模型优于零射入的大型数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 From navigation policies to agents.
blocks.zh: 2.1 从航行政策到代理人。

blocks.en: Navigation models learn instruction grounding and action selection from trajectories ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Language-model systems reason over observations and feedback ( Zhou et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , while recent agents control environmental interaction through tool calls ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . In NavHarness, adaptive goals guide execution, while verified completion governs goal advancement and memory compression. Appendix A provides an extended discussion of the literature.
blocks.zh: 导航模型从轨迹中学习指示地基和动作选择(张等,2024;程等,2025;Quen Team,2026). 语言-模型系统在观察和反馈上是理性的(周等,2024b;陈等,2024),而近代剂通过工具调用控制环境相互作用(李等,2026;周等,2026;陈等,2026). 在"NavHarness"中,适应目标指导了执行,而被核实的完成则制约了目标推进和内存压缩. 附 录 A对文献进行了广泛的讨论。

blocks.en: 2.2 Progress assessment and recovery.
blocks.zh: 2.2 进展评估和恢复。

blocks.en: Progress estimates and backtracking help agents detect and correct deviations ( Ma et al., 2019a ; Ma et al., 2019b ) . Recent methods incorporate explicit state reasoning or waypoint-based recovery ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . NavHarness makes each adaptive goal’s completion condition explicit through a verification question. The resulting judgment guides goal continuation, revision, or advancement and identifies completed interaction for compression.
blocks.zh: 进度估计和回溯辅助剂检测并纠正偏差(Ma等,2019a;Ma等,2019b.). 最近的方法包括明确的国家推理或基于方法点的恢复(Guo等人,2026年;Shi等人,2025年)。 NavHarness通过核查问题明确了每个适应目标的完成条件。 由此产生的判断指导目标继续、修订或推进,并确定已完成的交互压缩。

blocks.en: 2.3 Memory and context management.
blocks.zh: 2.3 记忆和上下文管理。

blocks.en: Navigation systems retain temporal context, structured memories, or language summaries ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2024b ) . Prompt compression and context-utilization studies further motivate selective retention ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . NavHarness ties compression to verified goal completion, preserving current observations and unresolved route information while summarizing completed interaction.
blocks.zh: 导航系统保留了时间背景,结构记忆,或语言摘要(魏等,2026;曾等,2026;周等,2024b.) 即时压缩和上下文利用研究进一步激发了选择性保留(潘等,2024;刘等,2024.). NavHarness将压缩联系到已核实的目标完成,保留了当前观察和未解决的路由信息,同时总结已完成的交互.

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation and Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务拟定和框架概述

blocks.en: Figure 2: NavHarness framework. Adaptive goals guide execution; observation-based verification provides feedback for the next step and goal revision or advancement. Verified completion triggers multimodal memory compression. The two situations illustrate route following and recovery.
blocks.zh: 图2:导航框架。 适应性目标指导执行;基于观察的核查为下一步和目标的修订或推进提供反馈. 被验证的完成触发了多模式内存压缩. 这两种情况说明了追随和复原的路线。

blocks.en: Given an instruction x x and an initial RGB observation o 0 o_{0} , an embodied agent must navigate to the specified destination in an unfamiliar environment. At interaction step t t , it selects an action or short action sequence a t a_{t} using the instruction, current view, and history. Execution returns observation o t + 1 o_{t+1} and an execution record. Each step may include several low-level movements.

As shown in Figure 2 , NavHarness organizes navigation around adaptive goals with observable completion conditions. The Goal Agent specifies a local goal and its verification question, the Visuomotor Agent executes actions toward the goal, and the Verify Agent assesses the observed outcomes. Verification feedback guides continued execution, goal revision, or advancement to the next goal. Verified completion also defines a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding history. The updated memory supplies context for subsequent goal generation, execution, and verification, linking navigation progress to context management.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,NavHarness围绕可观测完成条件的适应目标组织导航。 目标代理人规定了一个地方目标及其核查问题,维苏莫托尔代理人为实现目标采取行动,核查代理人评估观察到的结果。 核查反馈指导继续执行、目标修订或推进下一个目标。 被验证的补全还定义了内存代理压缩相应历史的边界. 更新了用于后续目标生成、执行和核查的内存供应背景,将导航进度与上下文管理联系起来。

blocks.en: 3.2 Goal Agent: Adaptive Local Goals
blocks.zh: 3.2 目标代理人:适应性地方目标

blocks.en: When observations or verification feedback indicate that the active goal no longer fits the scene, the Goal Agent formulates a corrective goal from the updated context. Figure 2 illustrates this distinction: a route-following goal directs the agent toward the yellow chair and then to turn left, whereas an unexpected stairway motivates a corrective goal to return to the corridor before resuming the route. The original instruction constrains the revised goal, and unfinished state is carried forward. Goal revision supports recovery without marking an unresolved route stage as complete.

blocks.en: The Verify Agent assesses goal completion after each interaction step, separating outcome assessment from action generation: p t + 1 = 𝒱 ⁡ ( x , g k , q k , o t + 1 , c t + 1 − ) . p_{t+1}=\mathcal{V}(x,g_{k},q_{k},o_{t+1},c_{t+1}^{-}). (2)
blocks.zh: 核查代理人评估每个互动步骤之后的目标完成情况,将结果评估与行动生成区分开来: pt + 1 = V → (x, g k , q k , o t + 1, c t + 1 − ). p_{t+1}=\mathcal{V}(x,g_{k},q_{k},o_{t+1},c_{t+1}^{-}). (二)

blocks.en: Here, c t + 1 − c_{t+1}^{-} includes the latest observation and execution record but excludes the verification judgment being generated. The Verify Agent produces qualitative feedback p t + 1 p_{t+1} that answers q k q_{k} , identifies supporting observational evidence, and reports unmet or uncertain conditions. It is instructed to assess completion against the observed outcome, with planned actions and expected landmarks defining the conditions to check. The feedback is then appended to the recent interaction history. For example, in Figure 2 , a question requiring both the green sofa and the doorway to be visible after a turn remains unsatisfied if only the sofa is observed.
blocks.zh: 在此,c t + 1 - c_{t+1}^{-} 包括最新的观察和执行记录,但不包括生成的核查判决。 验证代理生成定性反馈 p t + 1 p_{t+1} 答案 q k q_{k }, 识别辅助观测证据, 并报告未达到或不确定的条件 。 指示它根据观察到的结果评估完成情况,计划的行动和预期的地标确定检查条件。 反馈随后被附在了最近的互动史上. 例如,在图2中,如果只观测到沙发,则要求绿色沙发和门道在转弯后可见的问题仍然不能令人满意。

blocks.en: For an incomplete goal, the Verify Agent provides feedback on what remains to be achieved, guiding the Visuomotor Agent’s next interaction. A mismatch between the goal and the scene supports goal revision, while verified completion supports advancement and triggers memory compression. For the final goal, the Verify Agent assesses the instructed stopping condition and informs the stop decision. These judgments are based on the observations available during navigation.
blocks.zh: 对于一个不完全的目标,核查代理人提供有待实现的反馈,指导Visumotor代理的下一次互动. 目标与场景之间的不匹配支持目标修改,而已核实的完成则支持推进并触发内存压缩. 对于最终目标,核查代理人评估指示的停止条件并通知停止决定。 这些判决是根据导航期间的观测结果作出的。

blocks.en: 3.4 Visuomotor Agent: Goal-Conditioned Execution
blocks.zh: 3.4 Visuomotor 代理商:目标设定 执行

blocks.en: The Visuomotor Agent translates the active goal into navigation actions using the current observation, historical context, and verification feedback: a t = ℰ ⁡ ( x , g k , q k , o t , c t , p t ) , a_{t}=\mathcal{E}(x,g_{k},q_{k},o_{t},c_{t},p_{t}), (3) where p t p_{t} is the latest feedback for the active goal and is empty when no such judgment is available. The action interface supports forward movement, left and right turns, and stopping. A single interaction may execute a short sequence of movements before returning to visual assessment.
blocks.zh: Visuomotor Agent利用当前观测、历史背景和校验反馈将活动目标转换为导航行动: a t = E → (x, g k, q k, o t, c t, p t), a _{t → mathcal{ E} (x, g_{k}, q_{k}, o_{t}, c_{t}, p_{t}, (3)p t _{t}是当前目标的最新反馈,在没有这种判断时为空. 动作界面支持前进,左转和右转,并停止. 单一的相互作用可能在恢复到视觉评估之前执行一个短的移动序列.

blocks.en: The resulting observation and execution record provide evidence for the next verification step and subsequent goal updates. The local goal can thus remain stable across several interactions while actions adapt to new observations and progress feedback.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的观察和执行记录为下一个核查步骤和随后的目标更新提供了证据。 因此,地方目标可在若干互动中保持稳定,同时适应新的观察和进展反馈。

blocks.en: 3.5 Memory Agent: Progress-Aware Multimodal Compression
blocks.zh: 3.5 内存代理: 进步- 智能多模式压缩

blocks.en: To reduce repeated processing of completed interactions, the Memory Agent compresses historical context at verified goal-completion boundaries . Let b b denote a step at which goal completion is verified, and let H b H_{b} contain the multimodal interaction history accumulated since the previous compression boundary. The agent updates the existing memory m − m^{-} as m + = ℳ ⁡ ( x , m − , H b , g k , q k , p b ) , m^{+}=\mathcal{M}(x,m^{-},H_{b},g_{k},q_{k},p_{b}), (4) where g k g_{k} is the completed goal, p b p_{b} is its verification feedback, and m + m^{+} is the updated memory. The update consolidates the completed stage with earlier navigation history into three components: a summary of previously executed goals that records the traversed route, encountered landmarks, and their spatial relations; the associated verification outcomes; and a visual keyframe from each verification point. Together, these components retain a compact record of navigation progress and its observational evidence to support subsequent goal generation, execution, and verification.
blocks.zh: 为减少重复处理已完成的交互,内存代理在已核实的目标-完成边界上压缩历史背景 。 让 b 表示一个步骤,用以验证目标完成情况,让 H b _{ h_{b } 包含自上个压缩边界以来所积累的多模式交互历史. 代理更新了现有的内存 m − m^{- } 作为 m + = M → (x, m -, H b, g k, q k , p b-), m^{+}=\-mathcal{M} (x, m^{-)}, H_{-b}, g_{-k},q_{k},p_{b}), (4) 完成的目标为g k g_{k},p b_{b}是它的验证反馈,m + m^{+}是更新的内存. 更新将较早的导航历史的完成阶段合并为三个部分:记录所经过的路线、所遇到地标及其空间关系的以往已执行目标的摘要;相关的核查结果;以及每个核查点的可视键框。 这些组成部分加在一起,保留了航行进展及其观测证据的紧凑记录,以支持随后的目标生成、执行和核查。

blocks.en:
After compression, the updated memory replaces the detailed completed segment in the shared context. Subsequent decisions use this memory alongside the original instruction, current observation, and recent interactions. Evidence for the active goal and unfinished task state remains available.
Appendix C formalizes the agent state transitions, verification-driven routing, and history replacement, with the complete interaction loop in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh:
压缩后,更新的内存取代了共享上下文中详细完成的部分. 随后的决定与原始指令,当前观察,以及最近的互动一起使用这个内存. 积极目标和未完成任务状况的证据依然存在。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate 100 episodes each on R2R-CE and RxR-CE ( Krantz et al., 2020 ; Ku et al., 2020 ) . R2R-CE uses the Open-Nav subset shared by prior agents ( Qiao et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; RxR-CE generally involves longer routes and more detailed instructions. Codex CLI and NavHarness share backbones, episodes, and observation/action interfaces: both navigate from instructions and forward-facing RGB observations using forward movements, turns, and STOP, without reference trajectories or evaluator feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们评价R2R-CE和RxR-CE上各有100集(克兰茨等,2020;克等,2020.). R2R-CE使用由前代剂共享的Open-Nav子集(Qiao等,2025;Shi等,2025;Li等,2026.). RxR-CE一般涉及更长的路线和更详细的指令. Codex CLI和NavHarness共享主干,事件,以及观察/动作接口:既从指令中导航,又利用前向运动,转动,和停止,没有参考轨迹或评估反馈.

blocks.en: We report navigation error (NE, meters), oracle success rate (OSR), success rate (SR), success weighted by path length (SPL), and normalized dynamic time warping (nDTW). These assess final proximity, entry into the success region, successful termination, path efficiency, and reference-route agreement, respectively. Lower NE is better; other metrics are percentages with higher values preferred. Context consumption complements these measures to assess the cost of retaining navigation history.
blocks.zh: 我们报告导航出错(NE, meters),甲骨文成功率(OSR),成功率(SR),成功按路径长度加权(SPL),以及正常的动态时间扭曲(nDTW). 这些评估分别评估了最后距离、进入成功区域、成功终止、路径效率和参考程序协定。 低净入学率更好;其他衡量标准为优先值较高的百分比。 环境消耗是对这些措施的补充,以评估保留航行历史的成本。

blocks.en: With GPT-6-Astra, NavHarness achieves 79.0% and 82.5% SR on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, improving over Codex CLI by 5.0 and 6.2 points. SPL increases by 4.1 and 4.7 points, while NE decreases by 1.22 m and 0.72 m. GPT-5.6-Sol likewise gains 4.4 and 6.0 SR points; on RxR-CE, NE falls from 9.03 m to 7.28 m and nDTW rises from 41.2 to 47.0. These improvements, particularly the larger SR gains on RxR-CE, support coupling local execution to observed progress: adaptive goals reflect the encountered scene, while verification grounds advancement in completed outcomes rather than issued actions. Using monocular input in a zero-shot setting, GPT-6-Astra-based NavHarness exceeds Qwen-RobotNav by 6.9 and 6.0 SR points. It leads the reported SR on both benchmarks and NE and nDTW on RxR-CE.
blocks.zh: 随着GPT-6-Astra,NavHarness在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上实现了79.0%和82.5%的SR,比Codex CLI提高了5.0和6.2分. SPL增加了4.1和4.7分,而NE则减少了1.22米和0.72米. GPT-5.6-Sol同样得到4.4和6.0SR分;在RxR-CE上,NE从9.03米降至7.28米,nDTW从41.2升至47.0. 这些改进,特别是在RxR-CE方面斯洛伐克共和国的较大进展,支持结合当地执行以观察到的进展:适应性目标反映了所遭遇的情况,而核查则说明有理由在已完成的成果而不是发布行动方面取得进展。 在零射入的设定中使用单相机输入,基于GPT-6-Astra的NavHarness以6.9和6.0SR分超过Quen-RobotNav. 它领导了所报告的关于基准和关于RxR-CE的NE和nDTW的斯洛伐克共和国。

blocks.en: Goal reduces total tokens in all four settings. GPT-5.6-Sol saves 35.94% on R2R-CE and 56.59% on RxR-CE, with SR decreases of 1 and 2 points relative to Off; R2R-CE SPL improves from 47.9 to 50.3. GPT-6-Astra saves 5.52% and 4.05%, with SR decreases of 2 and 1.5 points and an RxR-CE SPL decline from 64.7 to 58.3, however, compressed SR remains above Native throughout. Text/Dec. falls by 55.5–71.6%, showing that completed-history summaries substantially reduce repeated textual input. Figure 3 reveals the corresponding temporal behavior: compressed traces repeatedly drop at goal-completion boundaries, whereas uncompressed traces continue to grow. The four episodes contain several compressions, with annotated local reductions of 27.7–48.1%. Verified completion thus provides recurring boundaries for consolidating history while retaining context for ongoing navigation. It is worth noting that local reductions differ from cumulative savings, which include internal calls, compression overhead, and subsequent execution. Progress-aware memory therefore reduces decision context, but the overall trade-off depends on the backbone: GPT-5.6-Sol gains substantial savings, whereas GPT-6-Astra shows modest savings and a larger RxR-CE path-efficiency penalty.
blocks.zh: 在所有四个场合中,目标减少总信使. GPT-5.6-Sol在R2R-CE上节省了35.94%,在RxR-CE上节省了56.59%,与Off相比,SR减少了1分和2分;R2R-CE SPL从47.9%提高到50.3%. GPT-6-Astra省下5.52%和4.05%,SR下降了2和1.5分,RxR-CE SPL从64.7下降到58.3,但压缩的SR始终高于土著。 文本/Dec.下降了55.5-71.6 %,表明完成的历史摘要大大减少了重复的文字投入。 图3揭示了相应的时间行为:被压缩的痕迹在目标完成边界上再三下降,而未压缩的痕迹却在继续增长. 这四集包含数个压缩,附加注释的局部削减为27.7–48.1%. 因此,经过核实的完成为巩固历史同时保留进行中导航的背景提供了经常性边界。 值得注意的是,当地削减与累积节余不同,包括内部调用、压缩间接费用和随后的执行。 因此,有进步意识的记忆会减少决策背景,但总体权衡取决于骨干:GPT-5.6-Sol获得大量节省,而GPT-6-Astra显示节省不多,RxR-CE路径效率处罚较大.

blocks.en: We deploy NavHarness on a Unitree Go2 quadruped using only RGB observations from a front-mounted Intel RealSense D435i (Appendix E ). Eight routes with reference lengths of approximately 15–20 m span corridors, sofa areas, classrooms, stairs, laboratories, and outdoor spaces, requiring ordered landmark decisions and scene transitions. Each route is tested three times (24 trials). Table 3 reports SR and mean NE alongside recorded baseline aggregates.

blocks.en: NavHarness achieves 83.3% SR and 1.51 m NE, improving over JanusVLN, the strongest listed baseline, by 33.3 SR points and 0.83 m NE. These results support the real-world effectiveness of NavHarness. The following cases illustrate how observed scene changes during actions inform the assessment of instruction-specific goal completion.
blocks.zh: NavHarness 实现了 净入学率为83.3%,净入学率为1.51米,比列出的最强基线JanusVLN提高了33.3分,净入学率为0.83分。 这些成果支持了纳夫哈内斯的现实世界的有效性. 以下案例说明了在行动中观察到的场景变化如何为特定教学目标完成情况评估提供信息。

blocks.en: The indoor route in Figure 5 follows corridor and lounge landmarks to a yellow chair with a white ball. The robot passes the black chair, aligns with the doorway, enters the room, and approaches the target. Crucially, clearing the doorway precedes the right turn, and seeing the chair precedes the final approach. These distinct stages illustrate how goal-specific spatial conditions connect local execution to completion assessment, rather than treating landmark visibility as sufficient progress.
blocks.zh: 图5中的室内路线沿走廊和休息地标走至有白球的黄色椅子上. 机器人通过黑椅子,与出道相接,进入房间,并接近目标. 关键的是,在右转之前要清出出出道来,在最后的方法之前要看到主席。 这些不同的阶段表明,针对目标的空间条件如何将地方执行与完成评估联系起来,而不是将里程碑式的能见度视为充分的进展。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Indoor scene transitions. Following ordered landmarks, clearing the doorway before turning, and approaching the yellow chair with a white ball.
blocks.zh: 图5:室内场景过渡. 遵循所订购的地标,在转弯前清出出出道来,并用一发白球接近黄椅.

blocks.en: The two routes in Figure 6 test adaptation and ordered progress. The sculpture instruction requires passing the bushes and building corridor before approaching the sculpture; the bicycle instruction requires reaching the green bicycle before turning left onto the ramp, then turning right through the corridor toward the trees. The latter explicitly distinguishes arriving beside a landmark from merely seeing it at a distance.
blocks.zh: 图6中的两条路线测试了适应并订购了进度. 雕塑指令要求在接近雕塑前穿过灌木丛和建筑走廊;自行车指令需要先到达绿色自行车后再左转上坡道,再右转穿过走廊去向树木. 后者明确区分了在地标旁到达的地标,而不是仅仅在距离上看到地标。

blocks.en: In the sculpture sequence, the robot realigns with the destination after an obstacle-induced adjustment and resumes its approach. In the bicycle sequence, it approaches the landmark before turning, reaches the upper landing, and continues toward the trees. These behaviors illustrate complementary roles of adaptive goals and verification: the immediate maneuver can change without replacing the global destination, whereas advancement depends on the spatial condition attached to the active goal. Appendix F provides further cases.
blocks.zh: 在雕塑序列中,机器人在障碍所引发的调整后会与目的地相接并恢复其方法. 在自行车序列中,它转向前接近地标,到达上起落地,并继续向树上行进. 这些行为说明了适应目标和核查的互补作用:即时行动可以改变而不取代全球目的地,而进步则取决于积极目标所附带的空间条件。 附录F提供了其他案例。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和结论

blocks.en: NavHarness organizes vision-language navigation around adaptive goals that connect action, verification, and context management. Our central proposal is to use observed task progress both to guide the next objective and to identify completed history that can be summarized. This organization retains the global instruction while allowing execution to respond to the encountered environment.
blocks.zh: NavHarness围绕将行动、核查和上下文管理联系起来的适应目标组织视觉语言导航。 我们的中心建议是利用观察到的任务进展来指导下一个目标,并查明可以总结的已完成的历史。 该组织保留了全局指令,同时允许执行对遇到的环境作出回应.

blocks.en: The current deployment has two practical limitations. First, reliance on remotely served closed-source models incurs substantial inference costs and communication latency, slowing the navigation loop. Second, a single RGB camera provides limited visual coverage: obstacles outside its field of view can remain unobserved, leading to unsafe movements of the quadruped robot. Future work will investigate lightweight VLMs for local deployment to reduce model-serving costs and communication delays, and explore navigation with depth sensing or panoramic observations to improve spatial awareness and obstacle coverage.
blocks.zh: 目前部署有两个实际限制。 首先,依赖远程服务的闭源模型会产生大量推论成本和通信延迟,从而减缓了导航回路。 第二,一款RGB相机提供有限的视觉覆盖:其视野外的障碍可以保持无所观察,导致四角机器人不安全地移动. 今后的工作将调查用于当地部署的轻量级甚高频,以降低模型使用成本和通信延迟,并探索有深度感知或全景观测的导航,以提高空间意识和障碍覆盖。

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩展的相关工作

blocks.en: Learned navigation policies connect instruction grounding, historical observations, and action selection. Recurrent VLN-BERT maintains a cross-modal state ( Hong et al., 2021 ) , HAMT explicitly encodes observation and action history ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , and DUET combines local grounding with global topological planning ( Chen et al., 2022 ) . In continuous environments, waypoint prediction bridges high-level decisions and movement ( Hong et al., 2022 ) , while ETPNav integrates online topological planning with obstacle-avoiding control ( An et al., 2025 ) . Scaling instruction–trajectory data further improves learned navigation and generalization ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . More recent navigation models use video-based action prediction ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , language-mediated locomotion ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , and navigation-oriented reasoning representations ( Zhou et al., 2024a ) . Qwen-RobotNav extends this line toward a scalable policy with an agent-facing interface ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . These works establish the value of learned representations and action priors. NavHarness studies how an inference-time framework organizes a general-purpose model’s navigation goals and execution history.
blocks.zh: 学习的导航政策将教学定位、历史观察和行动选择联系起来。 经常性VLN-BERT保持了跨模式状态(Hong等,2021年),HAMT明确编码了观测和行动史(Chen等,2021年),而DUET结合了局部地基与全球地貌规划(Chen等,2022年). 在连续的环境下,出站点预测桥高层决定和运动(Hong等,2022年),而ETPNav将在线地貌规划与障碍避免控制相结合(An等,2025年). 放大指令-导出数据进一步改善了所学的导航和通化(Wang等,2023年)。 更近代的导航模型使用以视频为基础的动作预测(张等,2024年),以语言为媒介的机能(程等,2025年),和以导航为导向的推理表示(周等,2024年a. Quen-RobotNav将这条线延伸至一个具有代理-facing接口的可扩展政策(Quen Team,2026.). 这些工作确定了所学表现和以前行动的价值。 NavHarness研究推断时间框架如何组织通用模型的导航目标和执行历史.

blocks.en: Embodied language-model systems connect semantic reasoning to executable actions and environmental feedback. SayCan grounds skill selection in learned affordances ( Ichter et al., 2023 ) ; Inner Monologue incorporates scene descriptions and success feedback into planning ( Huang et al., 2023 ) . ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions, and Reflexion retains verbal feedback for subsequent trials ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . In VLN, NavGPT explores explicit reasoning from textual observations ( Zhou et al., 2024b ) , DiscussNav organizes multi-expert discussions ( Long et al., 2024 ) , and MapGPT uses a map to guide adaptive planning ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Open-Nav studies zero-shot navigation with open-source language models in continuous environments ( Qiao et al., 2025 ) . Recent tool-calling agents and harnesses give the model greater authority over interaction and coordinate memory, feedback, and recovery ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; AMAP CV Lab, 2026 ) . This literature motivates both the reasoning model and the organization of its execution. NavHarness focuses on a shared goal representation through which execution, progress assessment, and context management remain connected.
blocks.zh: 健全的语言模型系统将语义推理与可执行动作和环境反馈相连接. SayCan将技能选择依据于学习的支付能力(Ichter等,2023年;Inner Monologue将场景描述和成功反馈纳入规划(Huang等,2023年)。 ReAct Interlevaves 推理与行动,Reflexion为以后的审判保留了口头反馈(姚等,2023;Shinn等,2023.). 在"VLN"中,NavGPT从文字观察中探索出明确的推理(周等,2024b.),讨论Nav组织多专家讨论(Long等,2024.),而MapGPT则使用一幅地图来指导适应性规划(Chen等,2024. Open-Nav 研究在连续环境中使用开源语言模型的零发导航 (Qiao等,2025). 最近的工具调用剂和用具赋予模型更大的权力,以进行互动和协调记忆、反馈和恢复(Li等,2026;周等,2026;Chen等,2026;AMAP CV Lab,2026)。 这种文献既激发了推理模式,又推动了其执行的组织. NavHarness侧重于共同的目标表述,通过这一表述,执行、进展评估和背景管理仍然相互关联。

blocks.en: Explicit progress assessment has long been part of instruction-following navigation. The Self-Monitoring agent learns auxiliary progress estimates from visual–textual grounding ( Ma et al., 2019a ) ; the Regretful Agent uses progress estimates to support backtracking ( Ma et al., 2019b ) . More recently, AwareVLN learns structured reasoning about spatial state and task progress ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , while SmartWay combines waypoint prediction with backtracking for zero-shot navigation ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . These methods show that progress estimation and recovery are established research questions. Our verification questions make the completion condition explicit for each goal generated from the encountered situation. The resulting judgment informs goal continuation, revision, and advancement, and verified completion also defines when the corresponding history can be compressed. Our focus is this coupling of adaptive goals, observable completion, and context boundaries.
blocks.zh: 明确的进展评估长期以来一直是跟踪教学导航的一部分。 自我监测剂从视觉-文字地平面(Ma等,2019a)学习辅助进度估计;遗憾剂使用进度估计支持回溯跟踪(Ma等,2019b). 最近,AleadyVLN学习关于空间状态和任务进度的结构化推理(Guo等,2026年),而SmartWay则结合了去向预测和回溯轨道进行零射导航(Shi等,2025年). 这些方法表明,进展估计和恢复是既定的研究问题。 我们的核查问题明确了因遇到的情况而产生的每个目标的完成条件。 由此产生的判断为目标延续、修订和推进提供了依据,经核实的完成也界定了何时可以压缩相应的历史。 我们的重点是适应目标、可观察到的完成和背景界限的结合。

blocks.en: Navigation memory must retain useful evidence while controlling the cost of processing past interaction. StreamVLN uses slow–fast context modeling and cache reuse ( Wei et al., 2026 ) , while JanusVLN separates semantic and spatial information into dual implicit memories ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Language-based navigation can also summarize history externally, as in NavGPT ( Zhou et al., 2024b ) . In general language-model settings, LLMLingua-2 learns task-agnostic extractive prompt compression ( Pan et al., 2024 ) ; studies of long-context question answering and retrieval show that supplying more context does not ensure effective use of relevant information ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Those text-task findings motivate careful context design without establishing a navigation failure mechanism. NavHarness uses verified goal completion as a navigation-specific boundary for summarizing completed interaction. It preserves information required by the remaining instruction and keeps recent evidence for the active goal. The distinction concerns when to compress and what navigation state to retain; summarization itself is an established technique.
blocks.zh: 导航内存必须保留有用的证据,同时控制处理过去交互的成本. StreamVLN使用慢-快上下文模型和缓存再利用(Wei等,2026年),而JanusVLN将语义和空间信息分离为双重隐含记忆(Zeng等,2026年). 基于语言的导航也可以从外部总结历史,如"NavGPT" (周等,2024b. 在一般语言-模型设置中,LLMLingua-2学习了任务不可知的采掘即时压缩(Pan等,2024年;对长文问题回答和检索的研究表明,提供更多上下文并不能确保相关信息的有效利用(Liu等,2024年). 这些文本任务结论激励了仔细的上下文设计,而没有建立导航故障机制。 NavHarness将已核实的目标完成作为归纳已完成交互的导航专用边界. 它保存其余指示所要求的信息,并为积极目标保留最近的证据。 区别涉及何时压缩和保留什么导航状态;归纳本身是一种既定的技术。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价议定书

blocks.en: The simulation interface provides a forward-facing RGB observation and four primitive actions: move forward by 0.25 0.25 m, turn left by 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} , turn right by 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} , and STOP. An external decision may request a short sequence of primitives. Execution returns an observation and a record of the actions performed, which are supplied to the Verify Agent for progress assessment. STOP terminates the episode.
blocks.zh: 模拟界面提供前向的RGB观察和四个原始动作:前进0.250.25米,左转15 ∘ 15 ^{\ Circ},右转15 ∘ 15 ^{\ Circ},和停止. 外部的决定可能要求一个短序的原始人. 执行返回观察和所采取行动的记录,这些记录将提供给核查机构进行进度评估。 停止结束剧集。

blocks.en: The instruction and observations are the task evidence supplied to the model. Historical records distinguish actions, observations, goal descriptions, verification judgments, and interpretations. The model does not receive the evaluator’s reference path, success label, or distance to the destination. The exact image selection policy determines which archived observations are actually attached to a request; a textual mention of a historical frame does not imply that the frame is visible to the model.
blocks.zh: 指示和观察是提供给模型的任务证据。 历史记录区分行动、观察、目标描述、核查判断和解释。 该模型没有获得评估者的参考路径、成功标签或与目的地的距离。 准确的图像选择政策决定了哪些存档的观测实际附在请求上;文字上提及一个历史框架并不意味着这个框架可以被模型所看见.

blocks.en: Visuomotor Agent Prompt Before moving, read the active goal and its verification question. Use the current RGB view, relevant navigation history, and available verification feedback to select actions toward that goal. Execute the selected movement actions in order, then inspect the returned observation and execution record. To look in another direction, turn and use the resulting view. A goal may span several interactions; do not regenerate it before every action. After each interaction, submit the returned observation and execution record for verification. Use the feedback to continue toward an incomplete goal, request a corrective goal when the current objective no longer fits the scene, or advance after verified completion. For an ongoing episode, complete this assessment before selecting the next movement sequence. If an updated goal is already supplied, continue with that goal. Respect the movement budget. Use STOP to end the episode when you judge that the instructed endpoint has been reached.

blocks.en: Execution supplies the observations and action records used by the other agents. Verification feedback supports the stop decision, but the inspected action interface does not impose an additional mechanical verification gate on STOP. On the physical robot, STOP may also end a run for safety and does not by itself establish successful arrival.

blocks.en: Memory Agent Prompt Combine the previous memory with the new execution records and observations. Summarize the previously executed goals as a record of the traversed route, relevant landmarks, and spatial relations. Preserve the associated verification outcomes, including corrections and uncertainties relevant to the remaining instruction. Distinguish observations and executed actions from interpretations, and preserve uncertainty. Describe the latest goal’s execution separately from earlier relevant navigation history without duplicating the same information.
blocks.zh: 内存代理提示 将之前的内存与新的执行记录和观察合并. 将以前执行的目标概括为穿越路线、相关地标和空间关系的记录。 保留相关的核查结果,包括与其余指示有关的更正和不确定性。 将观察和执行的行动与解释区分开来,并保持不确定性。 请在不重复同一信息的情况下,将最新目标与先前的相关导航历史分开描述。

blocks.en: Verified goal completion triggers memory compression. Revising an incomplete goal preserves the unsummarized interaction history so that subsequent decisions retain the evidence needed for recovery.
blocks.zh: 已验证的目标完成会触发内存压缩. 修改一个不完整的目标保留了未经总结的互动历史,以便随后的决定保留恢复所需的证据。

blocks.en:
We use the benchmark evaluators to compute navigation metrics.
Navigation error (NE) measures the final distance to the goal.
Success rate (SR) measures successful termination, whereas oracle
success rate (OSR) measures whether the trajectory reaches the
success region at any point. Success weighted by path length (SPL)
accounts for both success and path efficiency, and normalized dynamic
time warping (nDTW) measures agreement with the reference route.
NE is reported in meters, with lower values preferred; the remaining
metrics are percentages, with higher values preferred.
The real-world evaluation reports SR and final NE under the protocol
described in Appendix E .

An external decision is one logical request to the Visuomotor Agent
and may produce multiple environment actions.
Image/Dec. measures the mean number of input image instances per
external decision, while Text/Dec. measures the mean input text
length in thousands of characters.
These input counts include repeated history and inputs supplied to
the internal agents; internal goal, verification, and memory calls
do not add external decisions to the denominator.
Text/Dec. measures characters rather than tokens and therefore
cannot be directly substituted for Input or Total.
Likewise, image counts do not specify visual token consumption,
which depends on the backbone and its visual encoding.

blocks.en: Appendix E Real-World Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录E 真实世界评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate eight challenging routes with reference lengths of approximately 15–20 m across corridors, sofa areas, classrooms, stairs, laboratories, and outdoor spaces. Each route is tested three times with NavHarness, yielding 24 trials. The platform is a Unitree Go2 (approximately 70 × 40 70\times 40 cm in length and width) with a front-mounted Intel RealSense D435i camera approximately 70 cm above the ground. The USB-connected camera supplies 640 × 480 640\times 480 RGB images at a configured 30 FPS; depth, infrared, and camera IMU streams are disabled. Communication uses ROS 2 Foxy with CycloneDDS. Table 3 reports aggregate SR and mean NE across routes, retaining the recorded baseline values.

USB接通相机提供640×480 640\times 480 RGB相机在所配置的30 FPS;深度,红外,相机IMU流被禁用. 通信使用ROS 2 Foxy与CirconDDS. 表3报告汇总了SR和平均NE跨路线,保留了记录的基准值。
